objective: One separately reviewed near-ceiling live-camera characterization using the proven W7 transport. Keep the deployed streaming_ack_clock Host profile and permanent 40 ms Host backstop; reduce only the client dispatch floor from W7 90 ms to 40 ms, still one frame in flight and ACK-gated. Measure sustainable FPS, source freshness, jitter, Host send-to-ACK time, localhost/HTTP overhead, replacement rate and queue-depth invariants. No rate ladder, pipelining, retry, reconnect or reclaim.

readiness.required_followup: Run scripts/prepare_webcam_w8_windows.ps1 from Windows PowerShell. It rebuilds/stages only the webcam runner, runs adapter/transform/encoder tests including the fast-ACK 40 ms pacing control, exercises only the real read-only Host status endpoint, freezes exact hashes/evidence, and may then make this manifest grant-ready. It must not create a claim/session or touch the Ditoo.

target.pairing_precheck: authenticated exact target; no target override

transport.connection_shape: one connection; one frame in flight; one ACK per frame
transport.one_controller_rule: After a fresh named grant only: stop the MCP product supervisor and verify its session closed; Android Divoom app disconnected. OpenTivoo and port 8779 untouched. Restore MCP separately under its existing Runtime 003 policy after terminal close.

build.source_checkpoint: 7b30421 + W8 source changes; Windows W8 rebuild not yet frozen
build.identity_note: Host build remains the deployed W7-proven Runtime 003 Host. W8 changes only the Windows webcam client pacing/telemetry; exact rebuilt runner binary must be frozen by Windows prep before grant-ready.

session.shape: ACK-gated near-ceiling characterization with an absolute 40 ms client dispatch-start floor matching the existing Host streaming backstop. A prior ACK is always required; if ACK returns before 40 ms, wait only until the 40 ms dispatch floor. Zero packet spacing remains fixed by streaming_ack_clock. No pipelining.

Same camera/transform/Host protocol proven by W7; only client dispatch floor becomes manifest-driven at 40 ms and bounded telemetry is expanded. Exact source hashes are frozen now; Windows Release binary hashes remain provisional until the W8 prep rebuild passes.

camera.observed_rate_exception: Exposure-quantised 30 fps previously measured; see route section 11. Re-measure in trial preflight, do not promise 60 fps.

transform.palette_guard: closest weighted-colour pair, deterministic scan-order tie break, applied last

live_source.privacy: No saved camera stills or video; metrics only

budgets.derivation: min(floor(10000 / 40) + 1, 500) = 251 frames; 251 * 3 = 753 packets; canonical encoder worst-case is 1054 application bytes including both preambles, so 251 * 1054 = 264554 bytes.

stop_immediately_on: camera missing or no valid first frame before claim/open
Host profile not confirmed as streaming_ack_clock
target, firmware, source or executable hash mismatch
any Host refusal, HTTP/send fault or ACK timeout
malformed or unexpected report / canvas invalidation / stock takeover
10 second lifetime or frame/byte budget reached
stop_policy.on_camera_disconnect: Stop new submissions, allow an already-submitted frame to settle, request close once. Ambiguous close is unknown. Never resend, reconnect or reclaim.
stop_policy.on_host_fault: Terminal unknown; never resend or retry; cleanup must not overwrite unknown.
stop_policy.source_cleanup: Cancel capture/processor and dispose the reader/camera. Collection-continuation flag refers to existing MCP collection, not retaining webcam capture.
stop_policy.recovery: Restore the MCP product separately under Runtime 003 after verifying experiment terminal ownership; do not overlap controllers.

acceptance.transport: Characterize one clean 10-second run; zero retries/reconnects/reclaims/pacing refusals/encoder-hash mismatches; one frame in flight; queue depth max <=1; duplicate source frames = 0.
acceptance.rate: Target >=15.5 fps sustained. 13-15.5 fps is investigate-not-auto-fail if source freshness is excellent and transport is clean. Do not create a rate ladder.
acceptance.freshness: p95 source age at send <=80 ms target; inspect p95 by quarter for increasing age trend; latest-frame-wins replacement rate is measured, not treated as loss.
acceptance.timing: Report HTTP POST round-trip ACK timing, Host send-to-ACK timing, their bounded difference as localhost/serialization overhead estimate, and dispatch jitter separately. Do not call any of these optical latency.
acceptance.visual: Owner checks tearing/faults and whether the already-accepted webcam image remains usable at higher cadence.
acceptance.queue: Raw and processed slots are capacity one by construction; report observed max depth for both.

persistence_analysis.forbidden: firmware, gallery/persistent uploads, raw send, target selection, command enumeration, pipelining
persistence_analysis.product_policy_effect: none; Runtime 003 is not webcam authority

authority.grant_scope_requested: ONE 10-second W8 near-ceiling live-camera characterization to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 v42012 via existing typed Host 127.0.0.1:8796 and streaming_ack_clock profile; permanent 40 ms Host floor plus 40 ms client dispatch-start floor, at most 251 frames / 753 packets / 264554 application bytes; one connection and one frame in flight, zero packet spacing, no retry/reconnect/reclaim/pipelining; suspend and restore Runtime 003 separately. No rate ladder and no W7 authority reuse.

adapter.claim_handshake: Runner must produce one fresh valid 16x16 frame and emit camera_ready + nonce before WSL creates the durable one-use claim; only execute:<nonce> may cross the claim boundary.
